audit_metadata.method: Branch identity, operating status, and neighborhood were checked against official restaurant pages where available, then direct Tabelog pages. Michelin claims are asserted only when a current Michelin Guide restaurant page was located.
audit_metadata.michelin_note: A null distinction means that no current distinction was verified. It does not prove that the restaurant is absent from the 2026 guide. Michelin Plate is obsolete in the current guide taxonomy.
